reference_sql:
WITH daily_orders AS (
  SELECT store_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS order_day, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY store_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE)
)
SELECT store_id, MAX(n_orders) AS max_daily_orders
FROM daily_orders
GROUP BY store_id

solver.query:
WITH per_day AS (
  SELECT store_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY store_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE)
)
SELECT store_id, MAX(n) AS max_daily_orders
FROM per_day
GROUP BY store_id
